premise_notes: Substance true but citations wrong: verify.rs is 289 lines - check_diff is at :186-188 (not :501-503) and the bible/tones-only rule at :203-206 (not :408-418). choose() writes only the plan; PlanPage.tsx:25 lede and :74 read-only DiffView verified; server.rs:56-61 characters_root verified; no option.apply exists.
floor_notes: Gate mislabeled 'direction'; it is policy-loosen. It adds the first runtime write path into the git-tracked character package (bible.md, tones/*.md: the owner's character files) via an RPC, where the contract's norm is that runtime writes never touch the tracked package (contract.md:277). The written text is model output from a Reconciler whose prompt carries viewer-transcript-derived text (contract.md:244-245 - why lord.chat directives are only proposals), and bible.md/tones enter the brain's trusted, unfenced stable prefix: chat-derived content gains a persistent path into the trusted prompt. grounding_why: The claims hold but the verify.rs line numbers point past the end of a 289-line file.
falsifiability_why: Stale-hunk, swapped-sha, double-apply, all-or-nothing and guarded-revert cases are all red today and resist stubs.
reason: Policy-loosen: a new RPC write of LLM-composed, chat-derived text into the owner's tracked bible/tones, which feed the trusted prompt prefix - owner-only decision, not a challenge build.
